title: Building Regulation Clause Record
description: One machine-readable regulation clause stored in knowledge_base/ as a JSON record. Populated from source regulation documents (e.g. Technical Booklets) and consumed by matcher.py and judge.py.

clause_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this clause, e.g. 'TB-PART-F1-3.2'.

source_document.description: Title of the regulation document this clause was extracted from, e.g. 'Technical Booklet F1 (2022)'.

section_reference.description: Section/paragraph number within the source document, e.g. '3.2.1'.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the clause.

requirement_text.description: Verbatim or lightly normalised text of the regulatory requirement.

applies_to.description: Which drawing classes/subtypes this clause is relevant to, matching classifier_agent's taxonomy.

checkable_parameters.description: Structured numeric/categorical thresholds this clause imposes, for automated checking against facts extracted by feature_agent.

parameter_name.description: Name of the fact this threshold applies to, e.g. 'door_clear_width', 'stair_riser_height'.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes, exceptions, or cross-references to other clauses.
